mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, total_amount, order_status, pay_url) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{payUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, total_amount, order_status, pay_url, create_time, update_time FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
